title: EvoLen: Evolution-Guided Tokenization for DNA Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2604.08698v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tokens serve as the basic units of representation in DNA language models (DNALMs), yet their design remains underexplored. Unlike natural language, DNA lacks inherent token boundaries or predefined compositional rules, making tokenization a fundamental modeling decision rather than a naturally specified one. While existing approaches like byte-pair encoding (BPE) excel at capturing token structures that reflect human-generated linguistic regularities, DNA is organized by biological function and evolutionary constraint rather than linguistic convention. We argue that DNA tokenization should prioritize functional sequence patterns like regulatory motifs-short, recurring segments under evolutionary constraint and typically preserved across species. translated_title: EvoLen：面向DNA语言模型的进化引导分词方法
translated_abstract: 分词（token）是DNA语言模型（DNALMs）中表征的基本单元，然而其设计仍未得到充分探索。与自然语言不同，DNA缺乏固有的分词边界或预定义的组合规则，这使得分词成为一个基础性的建模决策，而非自然给定的选择。虽然现有的方法（如字节对编码BPE）擅长捕捉反映人类语言规律的词元结构，但DNA是按照生物学功能和进化约束来组织的，而非遵循语言惯例。我们认为，DNA分词应当优先考虑功能性序列模式，例如调控基序（regulatory motifs）——即在进化约束下形成的、通常在物种间保守的短重复片段。我们通过EvoLen将进化信息直接融入分词过程，这是一种结合了进化分层（evolutionary stratification）与长度感知解码（length-aware decoding）的分词器，以更好地保留……
tldr: 提出EvoLen分词器，通过将进化分层与长度感知解码相结合，把进化信息直接融入DNA语言模型的分词过程，从而优先保留调控基序等功能性序列模式。
en_tdlr: EvoLen is a DNA tokenizer that combines evolutionary stratification with length-aware decoding to directly incorporate evolutionary information into tokenization, prioritizing functional sequence patterns such as regulatory motifs.
